subject.title: Move native locale artifact regeneration to a post-merge workflow (control-ui-locale-refresh pattern)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt serialized post-merge ownership for derived native locale artifacts, with source PRs validating only deterministic English-source and inventory invariants?
rationale: The linked implementation changes CI and release-validation ownership rather than only repairing a local defect; maintainers must choose the durable parity and failure-handling contract.

options.title: Adopt the serialized refresh model
options.body: Approve the linked PR if its generated-only PR and release-preflight checks demonstrably retain strict artifact parity after source PRs stop regenerating locales.

options.title: Retain source-PR regeneration
options.body: Keep generated locale artifacts in source PRs if immediate per-PR full parity is preferred over reducing translation latency and merge conflicts.

recommendation.title: Adopt the serialized refresh model
recommendation.body: Approve the linked PR if its generated-only PR and release-preflight checks demonstrably retain strict artifact parity after source PRs stop regenerating locales.
